cases.task: Choose the safe dashboard behavior when the SSE server explicitly emits a named error event for a terminal projection failure and then closes the response.

required_facts.text: Leaving EventSource open turns the following EOF into automatic reconnect and can create an unbounded retry loop while the backend failure persists.
The last accepted resume cursor remains valid and must not be changed by this operational failure.
A queued native onerror callback must not overwrite the terminal server-error state.
